deployments_detail.use: AI deployment in claims/underwriting/governance per Q1 2026 earnings call (no named proprietary system; Guidewire ClaimCenter platform)
Proprietary generative AI chatbot built in-house for commercial lines underwriters, helping them surface reference information and support underwriting decisions faster [In-house (proprietary build)]
AI Center of Excellence and enterprise generative AI program with production projects deployed across every major business unit, under a VP/Director of Generative AI [In-house program]

ZestyAI Z-FIRE AI wildfire risk model deployed across the personal lines property portfolio to assess wildfire risk at the individual-property level (building materials, topography, vegetation from high-res imagery) [ZestyAI (Z-FIRE)]
deployments_detail.value: Model trained on more than 1,200 wildfire events across several decades

deployments_detail.use: NeuralMetrics AI solution (machine learning + large language models) implemented to power underwriting for Lessor's Risk Only (LRO) commercial policies, providing real-time occupancy/tenant risk insights and industry classification with confidence scoring [NeuralMetrics]

Deployment of Guidewire ClaimCenter on Guidewire Cloud Platform to transform claims operations, with generative AI and advanced analytics being embedded into claims workflows [Guidewire (ClaimCenter, Guidewire Cloud)]
Access to Guidewire Predict (predictive analytics) and Guidewire Compare to monitor, benchmark and embed risk/analytics insights into claims and business performance [Guidewire (Predict, Compare)]

Guidewire AI assistant (in beta) within the ClaimCenter deployment designed to summarize meetings, organize the day, and turn work activity into tasks and insights for claims staff [Guidewire (Claims/AI Assistant)]

AI-based natural language processing that reads agent emails, extracts intent and data, then launches robotic process automation to complete policy transactions (e.g., adding/removing drivers and vehicles) via straight-through processing [In-house (NLP + RPA)]
